items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: if they were played by a string section it could have been Haydn or something.

ctx.x: It talks about Irish nightsticks, he’d been hit on the head with an Irish nightstick and so it’s a whole poem that deals with the whole police culture. It’s just a couple of minutes, about two, three minutes. Then it goes into a classical — the finale is a classical sound.
Yes, that really struck me, like what’s the idea behind that? Like all of a sudden there’s these mostly major chords and if they were played by a string section it could have been Haydn or something.
